text: That Thanksgiving nap? It's not the turkey's fault.
Everyone blames tryptophan, an amino acid your body uses to make sleep hormones.
But chicken has about as much. So does beef.
And you don't pass out after a chicken sandwich.
The real reason is the meal itself: one estimate says about three thousand calories.
Piles of carbs, pie, maybe some wine... that's what makes you drowsy.
So the turkey? Totally innocent. Happy Thanksgiving!
